experiment: R7: ablation of unresolved categorical features slope, thal, ca (research only)

protocol.recipe: production: StandardScaler / passthrough / OneHotEncoder(ignore); LR(class_weight='balanced', lbfgs); CalibratedClassifierCV(sigmoid, ensemble=True)

bootstrap.metric_aggregation: per repeat, then averaged over repeats

classification.rule: dependence: dAUC CI high < 0 OR dLogLoss CI low > 0; non-inferior: dAUC CI low >= -0.01 AND dLogLoss CI high <= +0.01; label from the pair (95%), robustness from Bonferroni 98.75%

interpretation_guard: Statistical dependence on the Kaggle training encoding only; no clinical meaning is assigned to any code.

reporting_corrections.type: post hoc reporting correction; no rerun, no change to any original field or pre-registered label
reporting_corrections.issue: calibration_slope.repeats_ablation_worse treated a lower signed slope as worse; for calibration slope, closer to 1 is better
reporting_corrections.method: recomputed from saved per-repeat slopes as |slope - 1| (lower is better); saved paired-bootstrap Δ|slope - 1| reused; signed slopes reported separately with crossings below 1 flagged
